import bt,numpy as np
n=bt.signals();R=bt.train_returns().astype(float)
sh=R.mean(0)/R.std(0)*np.sqrt(252)
fam=np.array([s.split('_')[0] for s in n])
for f in ['hold','tsmom','ma']:
    m=fam==f;print(f,m.sum(),sh[m].mean(),(sh[m]>0.3).sum())
# half split stability
h=len(R)//2
s1=R[:h].mean(0)/R[:h].std(0);s2=R[h:].mean(0)/R[h:].std(0)
print(np.corrcoef(s1,s2)[0,1])
def test(name,w):
    r=bt.backtest(dict(zip(n,w)));print(name,r)
test('all_eq_sign',np.sign(sh))
for f in ['hold','tsmom','ma']:
    test(f,np.where(fam==f,1.,0))
sel=(s1>0.1)&(s2>0.1)
print(sel.sum());test('stable',sel*1.)
sel2=sh>np.quantile(sh,.8);test('top20',sel2*1.)
E
